correctness.rationale: The endpoint Markov presentations for a=3/7 and a=4/9 have characteristic polynomials respectively (lambda-1)(lambda+1)(lambda^2-lambda-1)(lambda^2-lambda+1) and (lambda-1)(lambda+1)^3 times the same quadratics. Both Perron roots are phi; survivor inclusion proves constant entropy over the interval and an expanding-cylinder Frostman argument proves dim_H=log(phi)/log2. Refinement by both endpoint grids yields only three recurrent SCCs; any periodic point in either newly retained open annulus must follow the forced six-cycle. Its six-step affine branch has unique fixed point at the OLD forbidden boundary, so no intermediate periodic points enter. At a=4/9 exactly two primitive boundary three-cycles are newly retained. Orientation-reversing side-address corrections give tr A3^n-P_n=(-1)^n and tr A4^n-P_n=3(-1)^n-6 1_{3|n}, which yield the stated rational zeta functions; 0 is one circle fixed point. Independently reassembled both exact matrices and enumerated all geometric periodic points for periods 1..12 at both endpoints and a sample interior parameter; the all-period assertion rests on the SCC and boundary argument, not this finite test.
